name: Divine Providence Fall
source:
You have taken the initiative to come to an isekai full of magic.
However, you have absolutely no ability to use magic, nor do you have any superpowers or supernatural abilities, and your body is completely ordinary.
In this world, every person has the talent to become a magician, you are no match for any magician, and those gods on high can easily destroy planets.
When you know that your lover is in crisis, that you are involved in the malice of the whole isekai, and that you will have to face several of the most powerful gods. What did you feel?
Anger? Powerlessness? A desire for great power? Even praying?
You felt nothing.
For in the 23rd century, there had once been countless civilizations in the universe. Before their histories were erased, they once described a civilization called Earth in this way —
Like god.
Now, in another world, you shall aid and witness a cohort of maidens ascend to the zenith.

[From [url=https://ulith-dev.itch.io/ulith]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你主动来到一个充满魔法的异世界。
然而，你完全无法使用魔法，也没有超能力或任何超自然本领，身体更是再普通不过。
在这个人人都有魔法天赋的世界，你不是任何一位魔法师的对手，而高高在上的神明，甚至能轻易摧毁星球。
当你得知，爱人身陷危机，自己被整个异世界的恶意包围，还必须面对几位最强大的神明时，你有何感受？
愤怒？无力？渴求强大力量？甚至祈祷？
你什么也没有感到。
因为在23世纪，宇宙中曾有无数文明。在历史被抹去之前，它们曾如此形容名为地球的文明——
如同神明。
如今，在另一个世界，你将帮助并见证一群少女，登临巅峰。

[摘自[url=https://ulith-dev.itch.io/ulith]itch.io[/url]]
